note: The generalized Natural Earth Suez Canal centerlines, including their separate mapped branches, over sampled terrain between the Mediterranean and Red seas. Relief is exaggerated 3 times; line width is a visibility symbol, not canal width. The source is generalized cartography, not a current engineering plan or full port-approach inventory. The independent 193.3 km ruler marks the catalog navigation-route length; neither map nor centerlines are stretched to it. Horizontal coordinates are not normalized to the catalog size. Colors are illustrative. The opaque sides and flat underside are arbitrary display cuts, not real cliffs or geological strata. Mapzen / Tilezen; SRTM, GMTED2010 and United States 3DEP terrain courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey; ETOPO1 ocean bathymetry courtesy of NOAA; Natural Earth public-domain map data; adaptation by Universe Scales. Ocean depths are sampled explicitly from NOAA ETOPO1 (1 arc-minute), using Natural Earth coastlines to select ocean samples; coastlines and land/ocean source transitions are generalized.
